summary: THE JOINT'S GEOMETRY IS MEASURED ON BOTH SIDES. The ring: cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders + bbox on seeed_bearing__configuration_default.stl reads hole Ø10.0 / boss Ø15.0 / 15.0 x 15.0 x 3.0 (frozen in the artifact), placed x3 (ankle_left, ankle_right, jaw_soft — spec/mesh-placements.json). The seats: microduck-shin 'ankle' Ø10.0 x 3.2 boss (inner ring) and microduck-ankle 'ankle_bearing' Ø15.0 x 2.3 pocket with Ø16 x 0.5 lead-in (outer ring), each measured in its own part folder off Pollen's meshes. compat.py graded the real ankle pair live: interface_names and nominal_size PASS, the rest honestly open. No vendor designation exists in the reference for this ring and none was invented.
by: claude (microduck connections lane), meshfeatures + interface scan

summary: ISO 286 LIMITS DERIVED AND CHECKED, WITH A MEASURED TABLE DRIFT RECORDED. From ISO 286-1's own formulae (i = 0.45*cbrt(D)+0.001*D, IT6 = 10i, k: ei = +0.6*cbrt(D)) the module reproduces published 10 k6 (+1/+10), 10 h6 (-9/0) and 15 k6 (+1/+12) exactly. MEASURED by this folder's self-test 2026-09-02: published IT7 in the 6-10 and 10-18 steps (15, 18 um) sits 1 um ABOVE raw 16i (14.37, 17.32) — the ISO 286-2 tables are not pure formula output — so those two values are TRANSCRIBED in compat.PUBLISHED_IT7_UM with this row as the record instead of a derivation that quietly disagrees with the standard everyone machines to. Self-test: 5/5 PASS after the transcription.

THE INTERFERENCE IS UNMEASURED AND STAYS SO, three named gaps: (1) the seats are FDM-printed PLA — a printed bore has no ISO class, slicer compensation moves a Ø15 pocket by more than an IT7 band; calipers on the as-printed seat (measured_d_mm) complete the fit check. (2) the unnamed ring has no vendor tolerance sheet to fetch; calipers on the actual ring (ring_deviation_um) complete the envelope. (3) partial engagement: Pollen's own ankle pocket is 2.3 mm deep for the 3 mm ring (the proud 0.7 mm clears the shin boss) — whether 77% engagement holds the press is a bench question; compat reports the ratio and refuses both verdicts.
